name: Postgres MCP Pro
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C4, C7; partly meets C1, C3, C5, C6, C8, C9, C10; does not meet C2.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The PyPI record for postgres-mcp 0.3.0 lists no project or repository URL; the repository's `pyproject.toml` declares the package name `postgres-mcp`. PyPI holds no provenance attestation for the release (the integrity record returned HTTP 404).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub's security-policy page for the repository says "No security policy detected" and offers no private vulnerability reporting; the README names no channel for security reports (searched for: security@, vulnerability, responsible disclosure, report security).

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived. The latest release is 547 days old (more than 180); repository activity falls within the last 180 days. Latest release 0.3.0 is dated 2025-05-16; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-08-16; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-08-17.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README documents a restricted (read-only) access mode; its configuration examples use the unrestricted mode. Quoted: “To use restricted mode, replace `--access-mode=unrestricted` with `--access-mode=restricted` in the configuration examples above.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The configuration examples pass the connection address through an environment variable; the development instructions pass it as a command-line argument. Quoted: “"DATABASE_URI": "postgresql://username:password@localhost:5432/dbname"”; “uv run postgres-mcp "postgres://user:password@localhost:5432/dbname"”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`uv.lock`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README discusses protecting databases in AI-driven use in general terms; it does not name prompt injection or untrusted content returned by tools. Quoted: “AI amplifies longstanding challenges of protecting databases from a range of threats, ranging from simple mistakes to sophisticated attacks by malicious actors.”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: mcp[cli]>=1.5.0. Lower-bound version 1.5.0 of mcp (PyPI) was published on 2025-03-21, between 12 and 24 months before 2026-11-14.
